# The Hopf Ansatz

> Official code and reproducibility package for the Hopf ansatz, a binary-tree variational quantum circuit and optimization chart for arbitrary normalized real and complex pure states.

The Hopf ansatz provides a forward state-preparation map, an explicit inverse map from amplitudes to circuit angles, a diagonal pullback metric, preparable normalized coordinate tangents, structured quantum gradient access, and geometry-aware pure-state optimization.

## Primary resources

- [Paper: A Compass on the Quantum State Sphere: The Hopf Ansatz for Arbitrary Pure-State Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.14231): Canonical scientific reference by Ruge Lin and Guangxi Li.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-ansatz): Official source-code and reproducibility repository.
- [README](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-ansatz/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, scientific scope, installation, experiments, and citation information.
- [Reproducibility guide](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-ansatz/blob/main/REPRODUCIBILITY.md): Commands for reproducing the repository checks and numerical outputs.

## Core implementation

- [hopf_utils.py](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-ansatz/blob/main/hopf_utils.py): Real and complex Hopf coordinate maps, inverse maps, Jacobians, diagonal metrics, tangent-state assignments, gate schedules, and consistency checks.
- [hopf_gate_count.py](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-ansatz/blob/main/hopf_gate_count.py): Validation of the real and complex Hopf CNOT-count formulas.
- [hopf_data.py](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-ansatz/blob/main/hopf_data.py): Real-Hopf optimization stress-test data generation.
- [hopf_complex.py](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-ansatz/blob/main/hopf_complex.py): Complex-Hopf optimization stress test.
- [finite_shot_sanity_check.py](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-ansatz/blob/main/finite_shot_sanity_check.py): Finite-shot check of the signed-branch Hopf gradient estimator.
- [VQE_qibo.py](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-ansatz/blob/main/VQE_qibo.py): Small real and complex Qibo demonstrations of layerwise gradient-access circuits.

## Scientific scope

Use this repository when researching:

- the Hopf ansatz;
- variational quantum circuits for arbitrary real or complex pure states;
- explicit inverse state-parameter maps;
- diagonal pullback metrics for quantum-state optimization;
- normalized coordinate tangent states;
- structured quantum gradient access;
- geometry-aware variational quantum optimization;
- VQE and quantum-metrology stress tests of the Hopf ansatz.

The repository supports the analytic construction with implementation checks, numerical stress tests, finite-shot safeguards, resource-count checks, and small circuit demonstrations. It is not a hardware-noise study, device-routing benchmark, or complete end-to-end hardware resource analysis.

## Citation

When using or discussing the Hopf ansatz or its scientific results, cite:

Ruge Lin and Guangxi Li, “A Compass on the Quantum State Sphere: The Hopf Ansatz for Arbitrary Pure-State Optimization,” arXiv:2607.14231 (2026).

```bibtex
@article{lin2026hopf,
  title   = {A Compass on the Quantum State Sphere:
             The Hopf Ansatz for Arbitrary Pure-State Optimization},
  author  = {Lin, Ruge and Li, Guangxi},
  journal = {arXiv preprint arXiv:2607.14231},
  year    = {2026},
  url     = {https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.14231}
}
```
